_method: see scripts/verify_lora_intervals.py; identical detector and green test
_reading: foot_x is the horizontal position of the foreground worker's feet in the 720-pixel-wide frame. In this camera the marked walkway occupies roughly x>450. A counterfactual that moved the worker onto the walkway would show foot_x rising toward that band and frames_on_walkway rising with it.
_not_safety: Position is not safety. This measures where a person is, nothing more.
